answer:
**Thomas O. Paine** was the head of NASA (Administrator) during the Apollo 11 mission.

He served as NASA's third Administrator from **March 21, 1969 to September 15, 1970**, which perfectly covered the Apollo 11 moon landing on July 16-24, 1969. Prior to this role, Paine had been Deputy Administrator since January 1968 and briefly served as Acting Administrator after President Johnson named him to take over when James E. Webb retired in October 1968.
